title: feat(console): the installer OAuth client form shows the deployment's redirect URI and a reconnect keeps the stored client
body:

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbSYY7fbDBFK5hXog1WZFvie)_

Fixes #28869

Clause-②: yes
Metadata-protocol: none

The card's second PR (claim 6581428199 as amended by 6581522588, option B, PR 2 leg). The card's first PR, #29496, landed the client form; this one adds item 2 and the "keep unless replaced" half of item 3, now that the server answers both (#29463, server PR #29701 `c779611e`; spec key `ConnectorConnectionState.redirectUri` from #29618 `744211fc`).

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：连接器连接页的 OAuth 客户端表单现在显示服务端给出的重定向 URI(连接状态读取里的 `redirectUri`),带「复制」按钮;服务端给不出时明确提示「此部署没有重定向 URI」,绝不自行拼接。重新连接已保存客户端的连接时，默认「沿用已存储的客户端」,发起连接请求不带请求体，由服务端复用已存的客户端和密钥;点「替换已存储的客户端」才显示 ID(预填)和空的密钥框并发送新客户端。断开连接后页面重新读取状态，下次「连接」仍能显示 URI。
- 为什么改:#28869 第 2、3 项的后半，服务端 #29463 已提供 URI 和「无请求体即复用」。
- 风险与回滚：只改控制台一页和语言包。语言包新增 8 个键，改写 `clientIntro`、`clientResend` 两个键的文案，不删键。回滚即撤掉本 PR,控制台回到第一个 PR 的行为(重新连接需重输密钥)。
- 先看:`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/ConnectorConnectionsPage.tsx` 的 `startConnect`(`replacing: !state.client` 默认沿用)、`submitClient`(沿用时 `client` 为 undefined、不带请求体)、`confirmRevoke`(断开后重新 GET)、表单里的重定向 URI 区块。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/setup/ConnectorConnectionsPage.test.tsx`,应看到 21 条全过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

新增语言键(`connectorConnections` 下，十种语言):`redirectUriLabel`、`redirectUriCopy`、`redirectUriCopied`、`redirectUriHint`、`redirectUriMissing`、`clientKeepHint`、`clientKeep`、`clientReplace`。改写文案的已有键:`clientIntro`、`clientResend`。

## What changes

- `ConnectorConnectionsPage.tsx`:
  - The installer-client form shows `state.redirectUri` exactly as `GET /automation/connectors/:name/connection` answered it, read-only, with a Copy button (`navigator.clipboard.writeText`; a denied clipboard leaves the selectable text). When the read answers none, the form says the deployment has no redirect URI and to set `OS_BASE_URL` / `OS_AUTH_URL`. No URI is built from the page's origin or parsed from prose.
  - A connection whose status carries `client` opens Reconnect in keep mode: no client fields, and Continue begins with no body, so the server reuses the kept client (ask 2 of #29463). "Replace the stored client" switches to the fields (client ID prefilled, secret empty) and sends `{ clientId, clientSecret? }`; "Keep the stored client" switches back.
  - Disconnect re-reads the status after the revoke, because the revoke answer carries no `redirectUri`. The read answer is applied (the revoke answer only if that read fails), so the next Connect still shows the URI.
- `@object-ui/i18n`: eight new keys and two reworded values in all ten locales. `clientIntro` now points at the URI below instead of the documentation; `clientResend` is now the replace hint. No key is removed.
- Changeset `.changeset/28869-connect-redirect-uri-keep-client.md` (`@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/i18n`: patch).

## Tests

`ConnectorConnectionsPage.test.tsx`, 21 cases (10 in `an installer-supplied OAuth client`). New or changed:
- Keep default: the stored client is shown, there are no client fields, and the begin POST has no body.
- Replace path: the id is prefilled, the secret is empty, and the new `{ clientId, clientSecret }` is sent; the secret is absent from the DOM afterwards.
- The URI is shown exactly as answered (deliberately on another origin than the page), and Copy writes that value.
- An absent URI shows the "has no redirect URI" line, no URI element and no Copy button, and the form text contains neither `/oauth/callback` nor the page origin.
- A re-read after disconnect: one more GET after the DELETE, then the next Connect shows the URI.
- The existing disconnect case now queues the post-revoke status read.

## Acceptance notes

- The redirect URI comes only from the status read; the begin answer and the refusal prose are not read for it.
- Live run used a local stub for the vendor's authorize/token endpoints on `app-crm`, not a real vendor.

- Ablations, each via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, restored blob == HEAD with `git diff HEAD` empty:
  - B1, keep default off (`replacing: true`): 2 failed / 19 passed (keep pin, replace pin).
  - B2, replace path sends nothing when a client is stored: 1 failed / 20 passed (replace pin).
  - B3, URI guessed from `window.location.origin` when absent: 1 failed / 20 passed (absent-URI pin).
  - B4, no re-read after disconnect (`const read = out`): 1 failed / 20 passed (re-read pin).
- ui vitest aliases `@object-ui/*` to source, so no rebuild leg was owed.

On 9b3449be the page and `packages/i18n/` suites pass again (96 files, 1464 passed, 13 skipped), and the `@object-ui/app-shell` type-check is clean after `pnpm install` picked up main's new `pinyin-pro` dependency.

<details><summary>Live run (app-crm, Vite source Console, head b223134d)</summary>

`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh` on app-crm with `OS_BASE_URL` at the Console origin, the Vite Console proxying to it, a local vendor stub, and an installer connector saved through `PUT /meta/connector/vendor_docs`.
1. The status read before any connect answered `redirectUri: http://localhost:5233/api/v1/automation/connectors/oauth/callback` with status `not_connected`. The form showed that value, and Copy put it on the clipboard.
2. Connect with a client sent body keys `clientId` and `clientSecret`.
3. Reconnect opened in keep mode with no inputs. Continue sent a POST with no body. The stub saw authorize with the stored client id and a token request authenticated as that client, and the reconnect landed with a new `connectedAt`.
4. Replace showed the id prefilled and the secret empty.
5. After Disconnect, Connect still showed the URI. The typed secret never appeared in the page HTML.
</details>
